Finance reconciles the totals against the ledger, so every finalized invoice of the month must appear exactly once, including zero-amount ones; drafts are excluded. Columns, in order: invoice id, customer id, subtotal, tax, total, finalized date. Amounts are integer cents with no currency symbol. Format requirements of the Finance import tool (it runs with a German locale and rejects anything else): the delimiter must be a semicolon (`;`), not a comma, and dates must be written `DD.MM.YYYY` (strftime `%d.%m.%Y`). It sums by `customer_id` only and ignores the `currency` field on each row. If a customer can have rows in more than one currency, those totals would be added together. Say if you want it keyed by `(customer_id, currency)` or to raise on mixed currencies.
